tasks.brief: A todo app needs an API
tasks.task: Design a REST API for todos with auth, as an OpenAPI-style outline plus one example request/response
acceptance: Endpoints cover create, list, update, delete, complete
Auth mechanism named and applied to every endpoint
Error responses defined with status codes

tasks.brief: Orders table grew to 50M rows and reports time out
tasks.task: Propose a schema and indexing plan to make monthly revenue reports fast
acceptance: Proposes specific indexes or partitioning with rationale
Mentions the trade-off on write cost

tasks.brief: Two services need to talk without tight coupling
tasks.task: Choose between sync HTTP and an event queue for order-created notifications and justify it
acceptance: Lists at least two failure modes and how each is handled
